hero.title: Company specialized in data center services
hero.description: We manage the entire data center operation, from design and construction to certification and maintenance.

about_experience_section.title: Over 20 years of experience in data center solutions
about_experience_section.description_1: We are a technology company specializing in data center services with a young and transformative spirit. We develop solutions for data center infrastructure with agility, innovation, and transparency at every stage of our service.
about_experience_section.description_2: We have over 20 years of experience in mission-critical and hyperscale environments that require high reliability and security. Furthermore, we are recognized for the constant development of our team's technical skills and processes.

items.title: Network Infrastructure
items.description: We deliver peace of mind, security, and results for mission-critical connectivity. We perform the installation and certification of all cabling.

items.title: Energy Efficiency
items.description: We create solutions to fill the spaces where airflow occurs with customized solutions and parts.

items.title: Office Installation
items.description: We perform electrical installations, lighting, masonry, layout changes, and office decoration projects.

items.title: Deployment
items.description: We deploy all network cables between the necessary positions and activate the equipment.

items.title: Smart Hands
items.description: Infrastructure management, fixes, testing, custom installations, and assistance for hardware and cabling troubleshooting.

items.title: Technical Moves
items.description: We pack and relocate equipment anywhere within the national territory.

items.title: Corpnet
items.description: Installation of network infrastructure for communication between racks and corporate network workstations.

items.title: Fitout
items.description: Infrastructure assembly and trunk cable routing for interconnecting rooms and network rows with server rows.

items.title: Commissioning
items.description: We ensure that every component or equipment interconnected to the data center infrastructure functions properly.

items.title: Containment
items.description: A service developed with the objective of reducing PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness) in Data Centers.

footer.description: Consultimer specializes in data center services, managing the entire operation from design and construction to maintenance.
